integrity: The marginal Student law and source algorithm are known; only the exact paired asymptotic and transition are proposed as new. Analytical proof supplied; finite tests supplemental; priority comparisons limited by accessible literature; no independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Two rows; one-dimensional row spaces; shared unit residual orthogonal to both; common standard real Gaussian forward-query matrix; fixed query count and fixed angle; exact arithmetic. No uniform near-alignment asymptotic, no higher-dimensional or nonlinear extension.
title: Sharp two-row catastrophic-tail transition in Gaussian forward-only reconstruction
